editorial.name: Pivot
editorial.descriptionZh: 采购流程的 AI 系统，把 intake、寻源、合同、应付和付款放进一套并接上 ERP。给采购与财务团队用。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看采购流程怎么被拆成九块再拼回一条链
editorial.noteZh: 顶栏一条荧光黄横幅写 Upcoming webinar: When everything is an AI agent, what actually is? → Register here to find out，下面是墨绿到荧光绿渐变的深色首屏，标题 The AI operating system for procurement.，标题上方一个小胶囊写 Built for the agentic enterprise，两个按钮是 Book a demo 与 Get to know us，导航有 Platform、ROI、Customers、Company、Resources 加 Sign in。首屏下方 100+ procurement and finance teams worldwide 配一堵客户 logo 墙（mangopay、Brevo、Voodoo、pennyLane、DOORDASH、Lemonade、FLiX、job&talent、EIT Food、DEEZER），再往下 What structure produces 一节把 Intake & Orchestration、Sourcing & Supplier Management、Contract Lifecycle、Procure-to-Pay、Global Payments、Spend Intelligence、Enterprise Controls 逐块列出，客户故事里 Flix 写 cut their approval times by 75%、EcoVadis 写 Slash its Cycle Time by 75% and Triple its Efficiency。

reasons.statement: 这是 Pivot 这款采购 AI 系统的产品官网，Platform 下拉下挂着 /platform/intake-orchestration 等九个子页，/solutions/* 再按职能分区，交付的是软件。
页面上没有可下载或可复制的产物，客户 logo 与 75% 这类 ROI 数字都属产品叙事，所以不归 case-inspiration-collections。

pages.title: Pivot | The AI Operating System for Procurement
pages.selectionRationale: 本条目采集于 2026-09-15 的首屏实测；手记描述的就是这一屏。

shot.alt: Pivot 首屏：The AI operating system for procurement.

facts.evidence: 全页只有 Book a demo 与 Get to know us，导航里没有 Pricing；想算账走 /resources/tools/coupa-roi-assessment 这个 ROI 评估小工具

facts.value: Intake & Orchestration、Sourcing & Supplier Management、Contract Lifecycle、Procure-to-Pay、Global Payments、Spend Intelligence、Enterprise Controls、AI Studio
facts.evidence: 首页 What structure produces 一节逐块列出，每块配一句解释与 Explore 链接，与 /platform/* 路径一一对应

facts.value: Flix 与 EcoVadis 各写 approval times / cycle time 降 75%
facts.evidence: The teams that proved it 一节六条客户故事标题，另有点名 Voodoo、Pennylane、Owkin、EIT Food
